subject: Shiny for a document management system

messages.author: b3c6a853a7f558c7
messages.subject: Shiny for a document management system
parts:
Hi Everyone

I want to know how I can use shiny as a document management tool.

I currently use the RPostgreSQL package toallow a user to write data to my database. I now want to allow users to upload files (specifically pdfs) and to store this either in postgres or googledrive or preferably on my server where shiny is running.
The fileInput function in shiny seems like it can do just that, but I dont know what to do once the file is uploaded.

Then secondly, I want users to be able to access the documents again. Here I have even less of an idea. I saw an example using iframes to view a pdf document in the shiny app, but how can the user download the file again? And how do you specify the source, the user will have to select it from some list.

Thank you
Jan
